frontmatterSnapshot.title: Hands on the box. Eyes on the room.
frontmatterSnapshot.description: Native software bridges that turn vintage Roland and Akai hardware into hands-on control surfaces for modern DAWs.
frontmatterSnapshot.intro: Hardware sits beautifully on the desk; the DAW does what the DAW does well. A bridge is a small piece of native software that lets a vintage box drive a modern session — transport, jog, locate, mixer — without giving up the editor on the screen.
frontmatterSnapshot.availableNote: Bridges you can download and run today.
frontmatterSnapshot.pendingNote: Bridges on the bench. Follow the GitHub org for progress.
frontmatterSnapshot.closingBody: The best old hardware was built for the hands. Buttons under your fingertips, a data wheel, a screen the size of a postage stamp because you don't need a big screen when the controls are this clear. The DAW brought modern editing power and gave away that tactile vocabulary. Bridges put it back — without asking you to leave the DAW.
